title: Increasing Proportion of BTO Flats within Mature Estates for Married Child Priority Scheme to Facilitate Inter-generational Familial Support
what_it_is: Increasing Proportion of BTO Flats within Mature Estates for Married Child Priority Scheme to Facilitate Inter-generational Familial Support

sections.label: MCPS flat allocation mature estates
sections.summary: 30% of new mature estate flats are set aside for first-timer families under the MCPS, and the proportion cannot be increased now.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Under the MCPS, 30% of the new flat supply in the mature estates is set aside for first-timer families.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: We recognise the importance of supporting the needs of parents and married children who wish to live with or near each other for mutual care and support and, therefore, set aside a significant proportion of flats of up to about one-third of our new flat supply in the mature estates under the MCPS.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Other than the MCPS, we also have other schemes, such as the Multi-Generation Priority Scheme and Senior Priority Scheme, as well as 3Gen flats, to facilitate mutual care and support among families.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Within our limited flat supply, we also have to meet the housing needs of other groups of Singaporeans, including first-timer families with children via the Parenthood Priority Scheme, and families with three or more children via the Third Child Priority Scheme.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Therefore, we are unable to increase the proportion of flats set aside under the MCPS at this juncture.

sections.label: BTO share and Proximity Housing Grant
sections.summary: The share of BTO projects in mature towns rose from 44% in 2017 to 55% last year, and resale buyers can get a Proximity Housing Grant of up to $30,000.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: The portion of BTO projects in the mature towns and estates increased from 44% in 2017, to 55% last year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Flat buyers who wish to live with or near their parents or children may also consider buying a resale flat and can receive a Proximity Housing Grant (PHG) of up to $30,000 for their flat purchase.

sections.label: Data via written Parliamentary Question
sections.summary: The Member could file a written Parliamentary Question to obtain the data she seeks.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: The data that the Member seeks, perhaps she could file a written Parliamentary Question, we can give her the data.
